Subject: MEMO: Lumena — onboarding surcharge waiver request (commercial exception)

Team —

Summary
- Account: Lumena Health (prospect -> expected close: Nov 2026)
- ARR ramp: ~$420k (Y1) -> ~$1.1M (Y2) per customer projections from PM & Solutions Engineering.
- Ask: waive one-time onboarding surcharge ($42,500 in current proposal) in exchange for a 24-month committed term + signed LOI by 2026-11-20.

Commercial rationale
- High upside: Customer roadmap includes additional product modules (embedding routing and dedicated caches) that would likely double spend in 18 months. The probability-weighted lifetime value (3yr) increases materially if we secure the Private VPC premium now.
- Competitive pressure: Lumena are evaluating two vendors; a clean T&Cs/one-line PO helps speed procurement and reduces implementation friction.
- Sales motion: this is a PLG-led expansion account; success here produces strong case study potential in payer vertical.

Financial impact & mitigations
- Immediate revenue concession: $42.5k one-time onboarding fee forgone.
- Modeled ARR uplift vs. churn risk attached in ARR_impact_model.xlsx (conservative scenario yields +$600k incremental ARR over 24 months).
- Proposed guardrails: waiver conditional on (1) 24-month term, (2) signed LOI by Nov 20, (3) 6-month clawback for onboarding services pro-rated if customer terminates early.

Precedent & policy
- Similar exceptions have been granted twice in 2026 for high-velocity payer pilots (see HubSpot notes). We should document the exception and set a naming convention for future precedent (EXC/LUMENA/2026).

Recommendation (decision required)
- Approve conditional waiver (as outlined) and allow Sales to mark the onboarding fee to $0 in the final PO.
- Approve marketing case study clause and a 90-day implementation milestone tied to invoice milestones.

Requested approvers: Markus (VP Commercial) and Kimberly (CFO) for final sign-off.

Attachments: ARR_impact_model.xlsx, Lumena_PremiumPack_Proposal_v3.pdf

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Commercial Strategy — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 14:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MEMO: Lumena — onboarding surcharge waiver request (commercial exception)

Marissa / Markus / Tessa —

Thanks for the clear memo and modeling. I approve the conditional waiver with the following firm conditions:
1) Signed LOI for a minimum 24-month term must be executed by 2026-11-20 and attached to the contract.
2) Include a 6-month pro-rated clawback on onboarding services if customer terminates early (language to be drafted by Legal).
3) Revenue must be recognized as per our ARR policy: no upfront revenue recognition for the waived onboarding amount; track as deferred revenue and perform a 3-month milestone check to validate implementation progress.
4) Sales Ops to tag the HubSpot deal EXC/LUMENA/2026 for future precedent tracking.

Markus: please confirm you are aligned on the marketing/case study ask. Tessa: proceed to close under these terms and get the LOI. Once LOI is in-hand, Finance will approve the final contract SOW for signature.

Kimberly Park
